_README: The realtor registry. Every entry becomes a page at /<slug>, and the generic
unnamed page stays at /. Adding a realtor is: one entry here, an optional
headshot, then `python build.py` and push. Vercel rebuilds on the push.
One page serves everyone: /<slug> is a rewrite onto index.html and the close
is filled from this registry at load. So a new realtor costs a line of data,
not a duplicated copy of the whole checklist.
An agent who is NOT in this registry is not blocked: /setup lets them type
their details and hands them a link that carries their own block in the URL
fragment. No deploy, no commit, no waiting on anyone. The registry is for the
Fields: slug, name, title, phone, email, site (optional), tagline (optional,
one short line under the name on the close), headshot (optional). A headshot
is the FILENAME under assets/headshots/, which make_assets.py produces from
assets/_source/headshot-<slug>.png. The build STOPS if the file named here is
missing, because a broken image on a client-facing close is a broken page.
Nothing here changes the checklist. The list is the same for every realtor
and every seller; only the person on the close and the personal details in
the fragment change. That is the whole point of it being shareable.
